title: Distinguish a reusable lesson from a local correction
actor: A reviewer or maintainer analyzing an engineering failure
goal: Identify whether a supported finding justifies reusable learning and distinguish its observations, inferred cause, and applicability.
context: A failure or review finding has been recorded with some observations and a proposed explanation.
trigger: The maintainer considers whether the finding should change later engineering practice.
preconditions: The finding and original activity context are identifiable.

interaction.action: Supplies the observations, their sources, and the proposed causal explanation.
Presents the observed basis separately from inferences and identifies the proposed mechanism, reuse basis, and applicability limits.
Assesses recurrence, reusable weaknesses, or broader consequences and records the lesson or local-correction disposition.
Reports the supported characterization and remaining evidence or applicability limits.

expected_outcome: A justified reusable lesson or a local-correction disposition is explicit, without treating a hypothesis as observed fact.

alternatives.condition: The finding has no reusable implications.
alternatives.outcome: It remains a local correction associated with its governing work instead of becoming a general lesson.

alternatives.condition: A single high-consequence event has supported broader applicability.
alternatives.outcome: The lesson records that reuse basis without claiming recurrence.

failures.condition: The proposed cause lacks support or conflicts with observations.
failures.outcome: The system exposes the contradiction or uncertainty and prevents a conclusive causal lesson claim.
